reason: $59 a month is a lot when library storytime and the parks are free, and I work remotely so I would not use it enough to justify unlimited. It looks nice, but it has not opened yet and I have no reviews to read.
objection: I can't judge how clean it is or read a single review before paying monthly, and $59 is steep when free options exist.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it open with strong reviews and a visibly clean space, plus a cheap trial visit or a drop-in price around $8 to try first.
